name: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

angles.text: Blacksmiths learning their trade in Elwynn Forest can forge a Sharpening Wheel to maintain equipment and hone blades in the field.
A proper campsite needs a reliable fire, so basic cooking training pairs well with metalworking in the wilderness.
Alliance artisans starting out in Goldshire can ask Smith Argus how to prepare for long journeys beyond town.

faq.answer: Smith Argus teaches skilled blacksmiths to forge a portable Sharpening Wheel for use in the wilderness.
Smith Argus is the blacksmith and trainer in Goldshire, within Elwynn Forest. He teaches promising smiths basic metalworking and camping craft.
A Sharpening Wheel is camping equipment that blacksmiths can forge to hone tools and weapons away from town forges.
Townsfolk frown on camps in settled places like Goldshire. Smiths need to head into the wilderness to set up their gear.
faq.q: Can you set up camp inside town?

aliases: do i need cooking for camping
faq.answer: A campfire completes a wilderness camp. Blacksmiths can visit a cooking trainer to learn basic fire-making before heading out.
faq.q: Why do you need a campfire to make camp?

faq.answer: Smith Argus teaches this camping craft to blacksmiths with sufficient skill.
faq.q: When can you learn this camping craft?

sections.body: Smith Argus of Goldshire shows skilled metalworkers how to carry their craft beyond the town anvils. Those ready for the work can learn to forge a Sharpening Wheel, keeping blades keen on long travels.
sections.title: Forging for the Trail

sections.body: Field gear alone does not make a proper camp. Goldshire townsfolk frown on camps within settlements, so crafters must head into the open frontier to use their equipment. A wilderness camp also needs a warm fire. Visit a local cook to learn the basics of making one.
sections.title: Life in the Field

summary: In Goldshire, Smith Argus teaches skilled metalworkers to prepare for work in the wild. They learn to forge a portable Sharpening Wheel and to make camp in open country with a proper fire.
